about.title: Bakersfield Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Thirty-six people did not make it home from Bakersfield's roads in 2025. That figure comes from Kern County public records, and behind each entry is a family now facing paperwork, funeral arrangements, and questions nobody prepares for. If the person you lost was killed on Union Avenue, White Lane, Panama Lane, Ming Avenue, or anywhere else in the city because someone else was careless, California law gives certain family members a way to hold that person or company accountable in civil court. A wrongful death claim is separate from any criminal charges the district attorney may or may not bring. It can cover funeral and burial costs, the income and support your loved one would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. LawProactive is not a law firm. We are a free service that listens to what happened and connects you with an independent attorney who handles these cases on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery. You decide whether and when to move forward.

whyChoose.title: Why Bakersfield Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on who can bring the claim
items.desc: California limits wrongful death standing to a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. An attorney can tell you quickly whether your family qualifies and how multiple relatives are handled.

items.title: The two-year clock is real
items.desc: Most California wrongful death claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window is considerably shorter when a city, county, or state agency may be responsible. Connecting early keeps those options open.

items.title: A civil claim, not a criminal one
items.desc: Whether or not prosecutors file charges, a wrongful death action is a separate civil matter that can address funeral and burial expenses, lost financial support, and the loss of companionship and guidance. The attorney you are matched with works on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery.

items.question: My brother was killed in a crash on Panama Lane and the other driver was arrested. Do we still need a civil case?
items.answer: The criminal case belongs to the State of California and focuses on punishing the driver, not on compensating your family. A wrongful death claim is a separate civil action that addresses your losses directly, and it can move forward regardless of what happens in criminal court. Under California law, siblings generally only have standing when there is no surviving spouse, domestic partner, or child, so it is worth asking an attorney who in your family is able to file.

items.question: How much does it cost to be connected with an attorney through LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free connection service, and we are not a law firm. The independent attorneys in our network take wrongful death cases on contingency, meaning they are paid only if there is a recovery, and any fee agreement is explained to you before you sign anything.

items.question: What losses can a wrongful death claim in Kern County actually cover?
items.answer: California allows eligible family members to seek funeral and burial costs, the financial support the person would reasonably have provided over their lifetime, and non-economic losses such as the love, companionship, and guidance they gave. Every family's situation is different, so an attorney will look at your specific circumstances rather than quoting figures. Remember that the filing deadline is generally two years from the date of death, and shorter if a government entity is involved.
